column1: # String table, wide-string formatter and the HUD text state of the five script commands.
# docs/strings.md; executed by tools/difftest_strings.py unless the note says otherwise.

column3: (key) -> wide text or 0; text_lookup without the miss ring; quotes dropped from the key
(dst, wsrc) low byte of each unit
(credits.txt data) skips the 2-byte BOM, cuts the UTF-16 text at CR/LF into g_creditsLines (up to 380 lines); not executed
float -> double in software, R5900 reading: exponent 0 is a signed zero, exponent 255 an ordinary number; executed on edge patterns
u16*[380] line pointers into credits.txt (credits_splitLines)
s8: position 0..15 of the last "NF:" text in g_textMissRing; advanced before use
u16[16][20]: "NF:" + 16 bytes of the missing key, sign-extended; returned by text_lookup on a miss
s8: set by hud_tickMessage (4 players offline, message running) and hud_spellSelect; cleared by hud_drawBust each drawn frame
float 0..1, stepped by hud_drawBust (docs/hud-dynamic.md)
s8 countdown: hud_setBust stores 5, hud_run takes one per tick; drawn while non-zero
s8 countdown: hud_setCompassTarget stores 5, hud_run takes one per tick; drawn while non-zero
s8: force argument of hud_showMessage; a forced message ignores the local menu and draws on layer 7
char[40] portrait texture name (strcpy, unbounded); 0x4f6b70 follows
Vec3 world position copied from the target object +0x10 by showCompass
wide-text pointer shown as the help box title (not a copy)
wide-text pointer shown as the help box body (not a copy)
u16[32] bust caption (wstr_copy, unbounded: a longer text runs into g_hudCompassLabel)
u16[32] compass label (wstr_copy, unbounded: a longer text runs into g_hudBustValue)
s32 showBust a: the value; drawn as a number when g_hudBustMax is -1, else as a meter fill; the draw clamps a negative value to 0
s32 showBust b: -1 = no meter
u16[100] one-line message (wstr_copy, unbounded: a longer text runs into g_msgIdGame 0x86ac40)
